name: 평상 대기
action: standing idle at ease: the whole body moves a little and naturally, the weight shifting slightly from one leg to the other, the shoulders and head moving a little with the breath, the ponytail swaying; small movements, feet stay planted
prompt: Shift weight gently from one leg to the other while maintaining a steady, grounded stance. Allow the shoulders and head to rise and fall with a rhythmic breath, letting the ponytail sway naturally to complete the subtle, fluid transition.

name: 놀라기
action: clearly startled: flinch back with the shoulders jumping up, both hands coming up in front of the chest, eyes wide and mouth open, hold the startled pose for a moment, then calm down and lower the hands
prompt: Flinch back abruptly as the shoulders rise and both hands snap up to the chest with eyes wide and mouth agape. Hold the tense posture for a brief moment before slowly relaxing, dropping the shoulders and lowering the hands to the sides.

name: 섭취
action: eating a snack: bring the right hand up to the mouth, take a bite, chew two or three times with the jaw and cheeks moving while the hand stays near the chin, then slowly lower the hand
prompt: Raise the hand to the mouth to take a bite, then rhythmically pulse the jaw and cheeks while holding the hand steady near the chin. Slowly lower the hand back down to the side, settling into a relaxed standing posture.

name: 뒷걸음질
action: hesitantly backing away from a scary enemy in front: one faltering step back, a short pause, then another step back, the upper body leaning back and both open hands raised, still facing the enemy; real steps, not sliding
prompt: Take a hesitant step backward, leaning the torso away while raising both open hands to chest height. Pause briefly with a tremor, then plant a second step back, keeping the upper body retracted and hands held defensively before settling into a stance.

name: 주저앉아 뒤로 밀려나기
action: sitting on the floor in fear, scooting backward: one foot pushes the floor, then the other foot pushes, alternating, the hips sliding back a little each push, hands behind for support, a slight tremble
prompt: Push against the floor with alternating heels to slide backward in short, jerky increments. Maintain a firm grip with both hands planted behind to stabilize the torso, while the entire frame vibrates with a continuous, jittery tremble.

name: 네발로 기기
action: crawling away on hands and knees: the limbs move one at a time in a crawling pattern, right hand then left knee, left hand then right knee, the knees moving separately, the back low
prompt: Advance with a low, hunched posture by planting a hand forward, followed by the opposite knee in a rhythmic, staggered gait. Maintain a hunched back throughout the crawl, alternating limbs with deliberate, heavy shifts in weight before settling back into a crouch.

name: 무기 대기
action: holding the submachine gun ready at the chest while waiting: slight breathing and a small body sway, the gun muzzle bobbing a little, feet planted
prompt: Shift weight slightly between the planted feet to create a gentle, rhythmic body sway. Coordinate the torso’s subtle rise and fall with the steady, rhythmic bobbing of the submachine gun held firmly against the chest.
